camel_example: aliyun quotas ListQuotaApplications --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode q_i5uzm3 --Status Agree --Dimensions.1.Value 'cn-hangzhou' --Dimensions.1.Key regionId --NextToken 1 --ProductCode csk --KeyWord Cluster --MaxResults 1 --QuotaCategory CommonQuota
description_en: Queries a list of applications for quota increases
description_zh: 查询配额提升申请列表
kebab_example: aliyun quotas list-quota-applications --next-token 1 --max-results 1 --product-code csk --quota-action-code q_i5uzm3 --status Agree --key-word Cluster --dimensions Value=cn-hangzhou Key=regionId --quota-category CommonQuota --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQuotaApplications

parameters.help_en: The token that specifies the start of the query. Leave this parameter empty to start from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记开始查询数据的位置。置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records to return for the query.

Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
本次查询的最大记录条数。

取值范围：1~200。默认值：30
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The approval status of the quota increase application. Valid values:

Disagree: The application is denied.

Agree: The application is approved.

Process: The application is in review.

Cancel: The application is closed
parameters.help_zh:
配额提升申请的审批状态。取值：

Disagree：拒绝。

Agree：审核通过。

Process：审核中。

Cancel：已关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to search for the quota increase application
parameters.help_zh: 配额提升申请的搜索关键字
parameters.name: key_word

element_fields.help_en:
The key of the quota dimension.

Specify `Dimensions.N.Key` and `Dimensions.N.Value` at the same time. The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud service supports. To query the supported dimensions, call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation. The value of N is the number of elements in the returned array
element_fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Key。

`Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数，您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of the quota dimension.

Specify `Dimensions.N.Key` and `Dimensions.N.Value` at the same time. The value of N depends on the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud service supports. To query the supported dimensions, call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation. The value of N is the number of elements in the returned array
element_fields.help_zh:
配额维度的Value。

`Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数，您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The quota dimensions. A quota dimension is an attribute of a quota. The combination of Dimensions and QuotaActionCode uniquely identifies a quota.

This parameter is required for some Alibaba Cloud services. To query the supported quota dimensions, call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation. The `Requisite` parameter in the response indicates whether a dimension is required
parameters.help_zh:
配额维度。
配额项的属性，维度（Dimensions）+配额ID（QuotaActionCode）确定唯一的配额项。
部分云产品维度必填。您可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回参数`Requisite`表示该维度是否必填
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en:
The category of the quota. Valid values:

CommonQuota: general quota.

FlowControl: API rate limit.

WhiteListLabel: privilege quota
parameters.help_zh:
配额种类。取值：
CommonQuota：通用配额。
FlowControl：API速率配额。
WhiteListLabel：权益配额
parameters.name: quota_category
